title: When Your Teen Stops Telling You About School
summary: When school stories get shorter, make the next small detail easier to finish: listen first, follow their thread, ask before advising, and check before retelling it.
seo_title: Teen Stops Telling You About School
seo_description: When your teen stops telling you about school, try listening to the small story, asking before you advise, and keeping safety checks separate from daily recaps.
release_move: The parent keeps practical and safety responsibilities while giving a teen room to finish an ordinary school story, choose whether to ask for advice, and set reasonable privacy boundaries.

core_belief_shift.from: I need a full school recap every evening to stay connected and catch problems.
core_belief_shift.to: I can keep safety duties while making a small voluntary story easier to finish without turning it into an investigation.

book_relevance.reason: The approved article names The Social Playbook Chapter 7 as an optional teen-owned listening parallel; the parent guide stands alone without the book.

hero.alt: A concerned parent gives her quiet teenager space across the kitchen table after school.

social_image.alt: A concerned parent watches her quiet teenager across the kitchen table while giving him room.
